posts.body_html: Photo courtesy of Brooks Garcia. He informed me this population of flavas is from Leah Wilkerson's property in NW Florida. There's another family member, Bud Wilkerson, who also had a property loaded with Sarracenias. Unfortunately, Bud passed away a few years ago, and there's no knowing if this population is being managed. Only hope is that they're still burning the site every so often...
